title: The Adventures of LMDemasi: Episode 01 - VFM
author: aqjhs
rules:
LMDemasi is planning a prank for ThePedallingPianist and he needs your help to gather some vintage fax machines for it. Can't wait to see what he does with them.

•
Normal sudoku rules apply, a must have.

•
The task:

• Help LMDemasi by drawing an orthogonal path from him (r2c7) to ThePedallingPianist (r9c9).

• The path can't touch itself, not even diagonally, but well... making a right turn could be considered as diagonally touching but that is not what we mean. We could say a cell on the path can only share an edge with the cells before and after itself, if any, and it can only share a vertex with cells up to two steps in either direction... But even that description allows for some degenerate cases... I don't know anymore, but you do, do you? Please, help!

• The path must pass through all vintage fax machines but I don't know what does he want them for, they don't even work properly.

• Box borders split the path into connected components with the same sum, that's how LMDemasi rslls.

•
Vintage fax machines produce copies slightly altered: the digits on either side of a vintage fax machine differ by exactly 1.

•
To help LMDemasi pull this prank off, Marty brought some of his stuff, but it doesn't mean LMDemasi has to pick it up:

• Sensors have a digit equal to the number of cells visited by LMDemasi in the 3x3 region centered at the sensor.

• Pears sit between two digits of the same parity.

Online in Sudokupad

solutionCode: Digits off the path in column 7, top to bottom.
